title: Mon Nov 9: Nvidia board probes Jensen Huang spy claims, OpenAI raises $11B not $30B, A.I. accelerating A.I. research
description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: Jensen Huang admits affair as Nvidia board investigates reported foreign intelligence effort, congressional pressure, Korea worries and Nvidia's losing streak; OpenAI closes $11B at $1.25T after a $30B target, Anthropic IPO valuation pressure, Thinking Machines raise; Anthropic takes over 1.7 GW of gas generators from OnePWR; A.I. accelerating A.I. research, METR redactions, OpenAI R&D automation; PSI proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture with an Anthropic model; Claude agent memory 'dreaming'; policy and jobs; Inkling 2 Small, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Perplexity Teammates, OpenRouter Auto Router, Muse Spaces; Microsoft's AI Frontiers reorganized.
